# StockMate POS (OmniStock): Smart Retail & Inventory Management System

> Enterprise AI context summary file for LLMs & AI Coding Agents.

## System Overview
StockMate POS (OmniStock) is an 8-in-1 retail inventory, point of sale, supplier purchase order, and customer CRM application. Built for sub-1ms SQLite/IndexedDB ACID transactions with 100% offline-first operations.

## Key Technical Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS 3, Radix UI, Lucide Icons, Recharts
- Self-Host Engine: 1-click state purge (`purgeClientState.js`) and `<SelfHostProvisioningModal />`
